'''''Kondo''-class assault shuttles''' were in use around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] had S-shaped landing struts and drooping wings. By [[44 ABY]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] had acquired at least four of these [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] for use in their [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]]. One ''Kondo''-class shuttle, the ''[[Obuuri]]'', transported at least fifty [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], including [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] and [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]] to find [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Abeloth]]. The ''Obuuri'' was destroyed en route to a [[Fallanassi village]] on Pydyr while searching for Abeloth.
